audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree row for row and match the packet: Fiora 1 through 4-5, Master Yi at 6, Skill at first item, Master Yi at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content spikes carry no cooldowns.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — the longest gate in the lane and the number that makes 'wait it out' actionable. Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s against Highlander's flat 85s, Lunge 13s at rank 1 falling to 6s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[1] and late now carry the W, R, Q and Highlander numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers repeatedly say Riposte stuns you. Riot's text is conditional: the stab slows the first champion hit, and stuns ONLY if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with the parry. Master Yi's kit contains no immobilizing effect at all — no root, stun, knockup or snare — so in a straight 1v1 her Riposte can never stun you.
audit.why: The page builds the entire lane around fearing a stun that a solo Master Yi cannot trigger. The real threat is that Riposte parries ALL incoming damage for its window, which blanks an Alpha Strike commit and a Wuju Style burst — a different problem with a different answer.
audit.corrected: Riposte (W, 24/22/20/18/16s) parries all damage and slows you; it stuns only off an immobilizing effect, which must come from an ally, not from you. Highlander's slow immunity ignores both that slow and Bladework's.
sources: ownerKit full kit — no CC in any slot

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is named nowhere, and the content layer instead says Wuju Style's true damage 'cuts through her vital-healing'.
audit.why: True damage bypasses resistances; it does nothing to a heal. Duelist's Dance restores health on every Vital and Grand Challenge heals her and her nearby allies, so anti-heal is the actual answer.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named in spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text and late.

edits.before: Fiora bullies you here — her Lunge poke plus Bladework out-trades your autos, and her Riposte parries your Alpha Strike damage and can stun you mid-combo, so never engage into an up W.
edits.after: Fiora bullies you here — Lunge (Q, 13s) plus Bladework out-trades your autos, and Riposte (W, 24s) parries all damage for its duration. It only slows you — you bring no CC for it to stun off.

edits.before: Your Highlander flips a snapshot fight: with the attack-speed and movespeed steroid you can burst her before her passive vitals and Grand Challenge sustain kick in, provided her Riposte is down.
edits.after: Highlander (85s) flips a snapshot fight — and its slow immunity ignores both her Bladework slow and Riposte's. Burst her before Grand Challenge (R, 110s at rank 1) heals her, and carry Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Late you out-DPS her once Riposte is on cooldown; Wuju Style true damage beats her vital-based healing in a straight fight if you dodge the parry window.
edits.after: Late you out-DPS her once Riposte is on cooldown — but only with Grievous Wounds applied, since her vital heals and Grand Challenge refill what true damage takes.

edits.before: With items it swings back your way: once Riposte is spent you out-DPS her, and Wuju Style true damage cuts through her Grand Challenge vital-healing — but the 45% win rate reflects how often she simply parries your all-in, so patience around her W is everything.
edits.after: With items it swings back your way: once Riposte (24s at rank 1) is spent you out-DPS her, and Grievous Wounds is what cuts her vital heals and Grand Challenge — true damage does not stop healing. Patience around her W is still everything.

edits.before: At level 2 her Bladework and Riposte threat dominate short exchanges.
edits.after: At level 2 Bladework's slow and crit dominate your short exchanges.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay hers because Riposte cancels your burst and her vitals out-sustain you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay hers: Riposte blanks your burst and her vital heals out-sustain you.

edits.before: Time Riposte to parry your combo and stun you
edits.after: Time Riposte to parry your combo and slow you

notes: The biggest correction here is that Riposte cannot stun a solo Master Yi — the stun requires Fiora to parry an immobilizing effect, and Yi's kit has none in any slot. Both layers assert the stun repeatedly; the content layer is corrected here, and the full layer (focus.text, phases[2].why, phases[4].why, tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, report[3].t, report[5].t) still carries it and needs the same sweep. NOT corrected because I could not verify it: the full layer claims Duelist's Dance vitals deal 'percent-max-HP true damage'. Riot's passive text only says hitting a Vital heals her and grants Move Speed — it states no damage type at all — so I left that wording untouched rather than guess, and recorded it as unverified.
